AccessControl.title: AccessControl
AccessControl.description: Global application availability switch controlled exclusively by the verified application owner.

isActive.description: Whether the shared application is currently active for all users.

pauseMessage.description: Arabic message displayed to shared-link users when the application is paused.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified owner who last updated the switch.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last status change.

/app_config/{docId}.description: Single-document global access control state (/app_config/access_control). Public get for real-time lock enforcement; strictly owner-only create/update.
